@@ -1,4 +1,38 @@
 def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                      rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                      distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
-    return unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes])]
+    """Select the next node to visit in a CVRP greedy construction.
+
+    Args:
+        current_node:    index of the current node (0 = depot)
+        depot:           index of the depot (always 0)
+        unvisited_nodes: array of feasible unvisited customer indices
+                         (already filtered to satisfy remaining capacity)
+        rest_capacity:   remaining vehicle capacity
+        demands:         demand of every node (index 0 = depot demand = 0)
+        distance_matrix: pairwise Euclidean distance matrix
+    Returns:
+        Index of the next node to visit, or 0 to return to the depot early.
+    """
+    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
+        return depot
+
+    cand = np.asarray(unvisited_nodes, dtype=np.int64)
+    d_cur = distance_matrix[current_node][cand]
+    d_dep = distance_matrix[depot][cand]
+
+    w = 0.5
+    scores = d_cur - w * d_dep
+
+    # light demand tie-break: prefer larger demand among near-equal scores
+    min_score = np.min(scores)
+    tol = 1e-9
+    mask = scores <= min_score + tol
+    if np.count_nonzero(mask) > 1:
+        sub = cand[mask]
+        sub_dem = demands[sub]
+        best = sub[np.argmax(sub_dem)]
+        return int(best)
+
+    idx = int(np.argmin(scores))
+    return int(cand[idx])

 def select_next_node(current_node: int, depot: int, unvisited_nodes: np.ndarray,
                      rest_capacity: float, demands: np.ndarray,
                      distance_matrix: np.ndarray) -> int:
-    return unvisited_nodes[np.argmin(distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes])]
+    """Select the next node to visit in a CVRP greedy construction.
+
+    Args:
+        current_node:    index of the current node (0 = depot)
+        depot:           index of the depot (always 0)
+        unvisited_nodes: array of feasible unvisited customer indices
+                         (already filtered to satisfy remaining capacity)
+        rest_capacity:   remaining vehicle capacity
+        demands:         demand of every node (index 0 = depot demand = 0)
+        distance_matrix: pairwise Euclidean distance matrix
+    Returns:
+        Index of the next node to visit, or 0 to return to the depot early.
+    """
+    if unvisited_nodes.size == 0:
+        return 0
+    w = 0.6
+    best_val = None
+    best_node = 0
+    for j in unvisited_nodes:
+        j = int(j)
+        d_cur = float(distance_matrix[current_node][j])
+        d_dep = float(distance_matrix[depot][j])
+        score = d_cur - w * d_dep
+        # light demand tie-break: prefer larger demand to fill capacity
+        tie = -1e-6 * float(demands[j])
+        val = score + tie
+        if best_val is None or val < best_val:
+            best_val = val
+            best_node = j
+    return best_node
